items.title: Base change of the naive cotangent complex of a presentation is an isomorphism on H^0 and onto on H^{-1}
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma fixes ring maps R -> S and R -> R', a presentation alpha : P -> S of S over R, and compares the base change of the naive cotangent complex NL(alpha) tensor_S S' with the naive cotangent complex NL(alpha') of the base changed presentation, asserting an isomorphism on H^0 and a surjection on H^{-1}; the canonical version for NL_{S/R} tensor_S S' -> NL_{S'/R'} follows from it (statement lines 22770-22786). The proof writes both complexes out for a polynomial presentation, identifies the base change map as a square whose two columns are the two complexes after base change, and gets the module statement from right exactness of the tensor product applied to the kernels I and I' (proof lines 22788-22803). The last step is a transfer from the chosen presentation to the canonical complex, and the author does it by invoking that the two complexes are homotopic to the presentation level ones (proof lines 22804-22806). The counted span is self-contained: it refers to no labelled item of the chapter and cites nothing.
